tooltip.luviteium.cool_hint: Hot cast. Cool with an Encased Fan blowing through water before use.
tooltip.luviteium.raw_processing: Heated Basin + Mechanical Mixer: 1 raw ore becomes 144 mB of molten metal.
tooltip.luviteium.casting_input: Insert a mold, then supply Molten Luviteium through pipes.
tooltip.luviteium.casting_output: Casts automatically when full. Cool the hot output with fan + water.
tooltip.luviteium.blank_mold: Use an undamaged sample in a Deployer over a Depot to imprint this reusable mold.
tooltip.luviteium.mold_hint: Reusable. The Casting Machine takes the required molten amount and outputs a hot cast.
tooltip.luviteium.bucket_charge: Carries 144 mB of Molten Luviteium, one ingot charge.
tooltip.luviteium.bucket_use: Right-click a Casting Machine to pour it in, or use an empty bucket to take some out.
tooltip.luviteium.generator_fuels: Burns plant biomass only (wood, planks, saplings, leaves, flowers, seeds). Rejects coal, charcoal, lava and bone meal.
tooltip.luviteium.generator_insertion: Insert fuel through a Create Funnel or Chute.
luviteium.ponder.casting.text_1: 1. Put Raw Luviteium in a heated Basin. A powered Mechanical Mixer produces 144 mB of Molten Luviteium per ore.
luviteium.ponder.casting.text_2: 2. Insert a reusable mold into the Casting Machine. Pump molten metal directly from the Basin into it.
luviteium.ponder.casting.text_3: 3. The machine accepts only the mold's required amount. Once full, it automatically casts a Hot Luviteium product. Armor comes out hot too.
luviteium.ponder.casting.text_4: 4. Blow air through water with an Encased Fan to cool the hot product. The result is the normal, cooled Luviteium item.
luviteium.ponder.molds.text_1: Place a Blank Mold on a Depot. Give the powered Deployer an undamaged sample tool or armor piece.
luviteium.ponder.molds.text_2: The sample is consumed. The resulting mold is reusable; damaged samples cannot imprint it.
luviteium.ponder.molds.text_3: Cast the head, then wash it with a powered fan blowing through water. Only cooled heads can be crafted with sticks.
luviteium.ponder.biomass.text_1: Feed biomass through a Chute or Funnel. The generator has one inventory slot holding up to 64 items.
luviteium.ponder.biomass.text_2: Connect shafts along the generator axis. While fuel burns, it generates 64 RPM with a total capacity of 512 SU.
luviteium.ponder.biomass.text_3: Burnable logs, planks, saplings, leaves, flowers and villager-plantable seeds are accepted. Coal, charcoal and lava are rejected.
luviteium.ponder.biomass.text_4: Fuel burns even without a load. The generator stops when empty and restarts when fuel arrives; redstone does not control it.
